page.overview:
Who is Bitterness Devil?

The の|Nigami no Akuma}} is a devil that embodies the concept of bitterness.

The Bitterness Devil has a large head with small horns, goat-like eyes, and a mouth with few teeth. It also has sparse hair on the top and sides of its head, as well as a scruffy stubble.

The Bitterness Devil's personality is currently unknown.

At some point after breaking free from Public Safety's trap, Pochita proceeds to erase more Devils by consuming them as he continues to rampage through the city, including the Bitterness Devil. Upon remembering Aki and Power while vomiting out the Snow Devil in the Aging's World, Denji pukes out the Bitterness Devil, restoring the concept of bitterness back to existence. This also causes him to remember Reze, Nayuta, Meowy, and his dogs after throwing himself into the nearby lake to refresh himself.
